name: Shannon Jones Isadore

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature biography describes Isadore as a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and business owner, born and raised in Northeast Portland.
Ballotpedia lists Isadore's career as including CEO of the Oregon Change Clinic and service in the U.S. Marine Corps.
bio.excerpt: Her career experience includes working as the CEO of the Oregon Change Clinic.

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Isadore lists her occupation as state representative, business owner and CEO, with a background in behavioral health and finance.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, Business Owner and CEO Occupational Background: Behavioral Health and Finance

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

bio.statement: Isadore lists a B.S. in psychology from Clark Atlanta University and a master's in family psychotherapy from Loma Linda University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Lincoln High School; Bachelor of Science in Psychology, Clark Atlanta University; Master of Science in Family Psychotherapy, Loma Linda University

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Washington County edition), p. 53

bio.statement: Isadore lists U.S. Marine Corps service and Oregon state representative as her prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: United States Marine Corps, Oregon State Representative
